# Top Flight Comedy

> Top Flight Comedy is an Austin, Texas–based comedy production company that creates sold-out live stand-up shows, private speakeasy events, and corporate comedy entertainment across Central Texas and nationwide. Founded by Austin comedian Evan Lopez. Tagline: "Comedy shows that take flight."

## Key facts
- **Business type:** Live comedy production company / comedy club promoter
- **Location:** Austin, Texas (primarily East Austin venues); produces events nationwide
- **Founder:** Evan Lopez — Austin stand-up comedian, featured on OFTV's "LMAOF" series
- **Founded:** 2024
- **What they do:** Stand-up showcases, private speakeasy nights, corporate comedy events, venue/partner residencies
- **Ticket prices:** General admission from ~$20; VIP/reserved and custom corporate quotes available
- **Drink minimum:** None
- **Talent:** Austin local comics plus nationally touring headliners with credits on Netflix and Comedy Central

## Services
- [Live Comedy Shows](https://topflightcomedy.com/#services): Weekly and monthly showcases at Austin's top venues.
- [Corporate Comedy Events](https://topflightcomedy.com/#services): Tailored performances for company parties, conferences, and off-sites; scalable to 500+ guests.
- [Private Speakeasy Events](https://topflightcomedy.com/#services): Intimate, secret-location shows with limited capacity.
- [Venue & Partner Productions](https://topflightcomedy.com/#services): Recurring comedy nights with restaurants, hotels, and clubs.
